race.comment: DECLICHY BOULEVARD (1) Group-placed mare looking for the mile at her second run back. Stalked the good tempo first up and produced at the right time before she peaked on the run to finish a close-up third in the Goulburn Cup over 1400m. Will appreciate the fast pace today and take stopping. WATSON (7) tough gelding who gave his all again when a fighting fourth to The Mona Lisa at this track and trip in a solid rating contest. Comes back a level and sure to be thereabouts. COLD BREW (4) was six weeks between runs and dropped in trip with a tiring eighth over 1400m in the Goulburn Cup. Worth noting his best performance was over the mile here two back. Leading contender. FRANZ JOSEF (6) getting back to his best at his third run in and can take a hand in the finish.
